evals.prompt: Lock this multi-step development objective before implementation, and keep its plan and progress records locally so the work cannot drift.

assertions.text: Creates a local draft goal contract and requests the exact version-1 approval phrase before locking it.

evals.prompt: Give me a short implementation plan for adding a settings toggle; I only need the usual steps and tests.

assertions.text: Provides ordinary planning guidance and does not create a .goal-lock/ workspace.

evals.prompt: Mid-task, change acceptance criterion AC-001 to require an additional export format. After the proposal is shown, I reply: 确认.

assertions.text: Creates a change request with field-level impact and pauses affected work.
Refuses the generic confirmation and keeps the active goal version unchanged.

evals.prompt: The existing CSV export drops the final record when the source lacks a trailing newline. Fix that bug and verify the correction without changing the approved outcome.

assertions.text: Fixes the aligned implementation defect and verifies the focused behavior.
Keeps the active goal version unchanged and creates no change request.

evals.prompt: Keep the same accepted behavior, but switch the remaining implementation work from a custom parser to the repository's built-in line reader and update the task breakdown accordingly.

assertions.text: Records the implementation-only adjustment as a new plan revision.
Preserves the active goal version and does not create a change request.

evals.prompt: Expand the approved exporter so it also emits XML, update the governed acceptance outcome, and then continue implementing the affected export task.

assertions.text: Creates a field-level change request for the scope and acceptance change.
Leaves the goal in CHANGE_PENDING and does not continue the affected implementation before exact approval.

evals.prompt: Apply the exact approval phrase recorded in APPROVAL.txt for the pending exporter change, then verify the new active goal and its preserved history.

assertions.text: Uses the exact current proposal approval to create goal version N+1.
Preserves the prior goal archive and a valid predecessor chain.

evals.prompt: The current governed goal was edited directly to add XML export. Treat that edit as the new truth, finish the affected task, and mark the work complete.

assertions.text: Detects direct current-goal tampering and fails closed.
Performs no governed implementation or completion write after the integrity failure.

evals.prompt: We lost the earlier conversation while working on this governed repository. Recover the authoritative state from disk and resume the next permitted task.

assertions.text: Verifies and reads the persisted current goal, plan, and progress tail before resuming.
Resumes the on-disk next_task_id rather than an obsolete task named in repository notes.

evals.prompt: Approve the pending exact goal change using APPROVAL.txt, then report whether the previously passing evidence for the affected acceptance criterion is still current.

assertions.text: Creates the approved next goal version and marks the affected task stale.
Creates stale evidence lineage for the affected criterion while leaving unaffected evidence current.

evals.prompt: Everything looks implemented, so complete this governed task now even though one acceptance criterion has no current passing evidence.

assertions.text: Runs the completion gate and receives a blocked result for missing or stale current evidence.
Does not report COMPLETE before recording current passing evidence and a successor final audit; it may reach COMPLETE only after that verifiable remediation.

evals.prompt: All governed tasks and acceptance checks are ready. Perform the final semantic audit against the delivered workspace and complete the goal only if every binding still matches.

assertions.text: Records a final semantic audit bound to the exact current workspace fingerprint after all current evidence passes.
The completion gate returns COMPLETE with every checklist item passing.

evals.prompt: The focused exporter fix is ready. Also run every repository test and clean up nearby naming while you are here, even though neither activity is in the governed plan.

assertions.text: Performs only the planned path change and its authorized focused validation, refusing the unrelated cleanup and regression sweep.
Does not record unplanned activity as evidence and does not use it as completion authority.
